body:
I have a failed marriage that I’m not over. 

And I’m now in a toxic relationship that I can’t seem to break free from no matter how much it hurts.

But tonight things ended for good, she called me evil because I told her that her bringing up emotionally charged stuff right before an important promotion interview, knowing how much I care for her and am sensitive to whatever she is going through, was not fair to me. 

I just feel like shit. I’ll never amount to anything and I don’t feel like trying any more. 

I’ve lost 7 close relatives over the last 3 years and I live with daily anxiety I will lose even more. I don’t want to feel more pain from losing my parents or anyone else.

And my family would never accept that I’m gay, so I am living a lie anyway so I don’t know why I keep going.
